summary: Tested Research Data endpoints + Health Period Explorer frontend/backend as per iteration_32 scope. All 30 backend pytest tests passed (datasets listing with 11 keys and counts, preview for every dataset, anonymize hides athlete_name/email + ATH-### codes, date filters bound rows, include_archived toggles counts, pain_reports region_display 'Other — note', xlsx export has README + 11 sheets, single CSV, multi CSV as zip, unknown dataset 400, coach restricted to OSTRC-only datasets, athlete 403, /health/staff/period-stats week/month groupings). Frontend verified end-to-end: Health Period Explorer renders with preset/custom dates/team/group, 'All time' shows 24/24 rows (July + Sept 2026), KPIs/chart/table/export buttons present, 'Only weeks with health problem' filters 24→12. Research Data page shows all 11 datasets with correct counts (athletes=16, morning_checkin=1339, training_sessions=858, pain_reports=475, recovery_checks=824, recovery_logs=540, ostrc_responses=24, ostrc_submissions=22, health_problems=11, cmj_tests=97, fittest_points=15), anonymize switch hides/shows athlete_name column, all expected test-ids present. Coach (non-admin) is redirected from /staff/research-data and does not see nav btn but still sees Health Period Explorer. Mobile 390px: both pages render with zero body-level horizontal overflow (body.scrollWidth === window.innerWidth === 390).
critical_code_review_comments: research_export_routes.py is clean (~418 lines, pure async, properly excludes _id). Minor: _in() uses string lexicographic comparison on ISO dates — correct for YYYY-MM-DD but relies on consistent slicing (done via str(d)[:10]).
health_problems filter boundary: skips when last_reported_date < start OR first_reported_date > end — correct intersection check.
